corrections: Replaced the generic fighter with a dedicated 9.12 airframe: broad LERX, separated intake ducts, flattened twin engine pods, 6-degree canted finite-thickness fins, correctly swept wings and stabilators, nose IRST and pitot.

Overlay iterations moved the fins aft, corrected the stabilator leading edges, refined the pod cross-sections and rebuilt the canopy around a recessed gray analog cockpit. Closed the canopy sill gaps and moved the seat headbox inside the rear canopy.

Added actual panel apertures, original-style paired engine instruments, fuel/system instruments, radar hood, HUD structure, K-36-style seat, wide control grip and paired throttle levers. Unsupported engine and navigation data remains unavailable.

Added metric flight instruments, signed altitude digits, independent bank/pitch, true heading, load factor, moving stick/pedals/throttles, retracting gear, slats/flaps, ailerons, swept-hinge rudders and mixed stabilators. Surface lines and rivets follow the faceted wing surfaces.
reviewNotes.independentDimensions: GAF manual Figure 1-0: 17.32m overall, 16.28m without pitot, 11.36m span, 4.73m height, 7.78m stabilator span, 6-degree fin cant, 3.10m main track and 3.645m wheelbase. Uniform exterior overlay scale checked independently across three views. Cockpit scale estimated from an approximately 128mm ADI aperture; not a measured cockpit station drawing.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected final-hash side/top/front/panel overlays, all eight standard captures and twelve close/detail/state captures. Checked zero, cruise, limits, below-sea-level and missing-data instruments, both control directions, gear-up clean flight, canopy fit, intake/nozzle depth and surface details. Targeted geometry and metric/hinge/cardinal tests passed; all 22 shared instrument tests passed before the final sill-only geometry correction.
limitations: Exterior drawings are an illustrator reconstruction cross-checked against a manufacturer-derived service manual and museum photo; intake cross-sections and body stations remain approximations.

Cockpit layout follows circa-1995 analog MiG-29 photographs with estimated dimensions and perspective/occlusion. English labels, dial calibrations and the blue/brown artificial horizon are simulator adaptations.

Displays use true airspeed, geometric altitude and true heading; no pitot/static, magnetic compass, radar, fuel, engine-temperature/RPM, hydraulic, oxygen or failure-system simulation is implied. Unsupported readings are blank/INOP.
HUD is physical structure without collimated symbology. Intake geometry is the fixed open-main-inlet/closed-upper-louver flight configuration; FOD ramps do not transition with ground operations.
Gear and controls are simplified visual mechanisms. Seams and rivets are selective approximations, not a manufacturing fastener schedule. No external weapons, stores or unit markings.
